title: All GTA 6 Cheats And How To Unlock Them
summary: At first glance, it might seem like Grand Theft Auto 6 has no cheats system. However, it's a GTA game, so it does exist in there somewhere--there are just a few prerequisites you need to complete before you can use it. In fact, if you try to use any of these GTA 6 cheat codes before you've completed the below steps, you'll be unsuccessful. We loaded a fresh save to test that, so you don't have to. There are also challenges tied to each of the cheat codes, so it could be quite some time before you unlock them all. Having said that, the game does take into account the challenges you've already completed before unlocking cheats. That's just how it is this time around. That's a pretty sharp departure from the rest of the games in the series, where you could use them from the start of a fresh save, but it does lean into forcing your first playthrough to be as realistic as possible--something that Rockstar has strived for with GTA 6. However, it's important to note that if you use a cheat, you will not be able to save your game after that .
